featured_reviews.name: Burjiz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai Central Snacks and Juice Centre is one of those convenient little spots right near Mumbai Central railway station and close to the bridge at Nathani Heights.

There are two shops. The one I usually go to is the one at the right of the building and near the entry point of the internal building parking.

It's mainly a takeaway kind of place, especially since there’s no real seating unless you’re okay just standing outside and eating. But for what it is, it works well.

I’ve tried their veg club grill here multiple times and that’s something I’d recommend as it's good and quote filling.

The fruit juices are fresh as well, and overall the menu covers a decent range of quick bites like burgers, pizza, pav bhaji, etc. It’s all pure vegetarian, which is worth keeping in mind.

Another plus is that it stays open quite late, which makes it a reliable option if you’re around the area at night and looking for something quick.

Pricing is reasonable, portions are fair, and service is generally quick and efficient which is basically what you’d expect from a place like this.

Not somewhere you’d go to sit and relax, but for a quick bite or takeaway near Mumbai Central, it does the job well.

featured_reviews.name: fane 12
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smoothie Factory – Where Health Meets Indulgence!

Are you an athlete, a fitness freak, or just someone who’s tired of every food joint drowning your meal in sugar, oil, or butter? If stepping out to eat feels like a battle against unhealthy choices, then Smoothie Factory is your ultimate safe haven!

What makes them special? EVERYTHING is made fresh. No shortcuts, no preservatives—just pure, wholesome goodness.

We decided to put their healthy promise to the test, and here’s what we tried:

🥜 PB&J Protein Acai Bowl (4/5) – This bowl is a meal in itself! Packed with granola, banana, strawberries, blueberries, and a peanut butter drizzle, it’s as nutritious as it is delicious. Fair warning: it’s super filling, so come hungry!

🍓 Very Berry Smoothie (4/5) – A delightful mix of rich berries, soy milk, and honey, this smoothie nails the balance between sweet and refreshing. The texture? Thick and satisfying—exactly how a smoothie should be!

🍈 Guava Kiss (5/5) – If you love guava, this is a must-try. Bursting with tropical goodness, it’s easily one of the best guava-based drinks we’ve ever had.

🍊 100% Orange Juice (5/5) – No gimmicks, no additives—just freshly squeezed, pure orange juice. Simple, classic, and absolutely perfect.

🍦 Frozen Yogurt (5/5) – DO NOT leave without trying this! We had the Chocolate & Strawberry Frozen Yogurt, and let’s just say—it’s on another level. Creamy, rich, and guilt-free, it’s the perfect sweet treat.

Final Verdict: If you want to eat to your heart’s content without compromising on health, Smoothie Factory is the place to be. Fresh, flavorful, and packed with nutrition—what more could you ask for?

featured_reviews.review_text:
I wanted to visit some good places where I can try a variety of juice and shakes so I visited the craufet market, so I tried searching for some famous stalls or places for food/juice for which I got to know that "Pappu Juice wala" is pretty famous on Mohammad Ali Road. I saw the pictures and decided to visit.

So the stall is at the main road itself, you will easily locate it via Google map. So they provide juice and shakes according to season, currently strawberry is the main fruit. The cost of juice/shakes is very economical you can try it in the range of Rs50-Rs200 all the juices.

They use fresh fruits and everything, they cut the fruits right in front of you. The only thing I did not like was the hygiene. So just next to the stall they have a dustbin where you can throw you cutleries and everything and they throw the residue of the fruits. So, this dustbin attracts lots of flies and other insects. At the same time due to too many crowds they keep cutting the fruit continuously for the juice and shakes but they do not cover it with anything, so the fruit pieces are open and the shop is on the road and they have a dustbin as well next to the stall. So I will definitely recommend them to change this.

Talking about the shakes you shall definitely try the strawberry 🍓 cream shake, they use fresh strawberry and cream it is recommended.
Whereas you can also try coconut cream shake, they serve it in the coconut shell. I am not much of a fan of 🥥 coconut thus I did not like it, but my friends love it. so you shall definitely try that too. It's an all season thing.

Rest I am sharing the photos which you can see and judge accordingly.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Haji Ali Juice Centre after visiting Haji Ali Dargah as we wanted to have some fresh juice. Even though I was having cold and cough, I still wanted to try something here. We noticed many varieties of cream puddings displayed, which looked very tempting. Since it was our first time, we asked the staff which one was the best, and they suggested the Seetha Phal (custard apple) cream pudding, so we ordered that along with rose milk falooda.
As they said, the Seetha Phal cream pudding was extraordinary and super in taste, very rich and satisfying. The rose milk falooda was good, but not as special as the pudding. They also serve many other juices, desserts, and snacks.
Prices are definitely on the higher side, and most items feel expensive. The ambience is simple and nothing fancy, and the service is just okay. Overall, the Seetha Phal cream pudding is highly recommended if you visit here.

featured_reviews.name: Sakib Mulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
A perennial favorite among locals and tourists alike, Haji Ali Juice Centre is an iconic culinary landmark nestled at the threshold of the historic Haji Ali Dargah. Since its inception in the 1960s, this bustling establishment has cultivated a legendary status, evolving from a modest stop for pilgrims into a vibrant gastronomic institution. It is celebrated for its unwavering commitment to quality, utilizing fresh, seasonal ingredients to craft an extensive repertoire of refreshments that have become synonymous with Mumbai's street food culture.
Reviewers frequently highlight the establishment's ability to maintain high standards of hygiene and flavor despite the immense daily crowds. The atmosphere is quintessentially Mumbai—a high-energy, casual setting where patrons often enjoy their treats standing on the pavement or from the comfort of their cars, adding a unique drive-in charm to the experience.
• Signature Fruit Creams: The "Sitaphal" (custard apple) cream is universally acclaimed as a must-try masterpiece, featuring a luscious, thick consistency generously laden with fresh fruit chunks.
• Exotic Shakes & Juices: Guests often praise the Mango Milkshake for its rich, creamy texture and the "Triveni"—a sophisticated blend of mango, strawberry, and kiwi juices.
• Savoury Accompaniments: Beyond beverages, the menu boasts popular fusion snacks like the Jain Pizza and the indulgent Cheese Toast, noted for its generous cheese-to-bread ratio.
• Late-Night Accessibility: Operating from the early morning until well past midnight, it serves as a reliable sanctuary for night revelers seeking high-quality refreshments.

featured_reviews.name: Patricia
featured_reviews.review_text: The Haji Ali Juice centre is such an iconic eatery in Mumbai. It's a must visit if you are visiting Mumbai for the first time for sure. They have some of the most delicious shakes and ice creams. But my favourite is the strawberry cream. It's absolutely delicious. Having ice cream late at night near the sea is such a fun experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sanoop ks
featured_reviews.review_text:
Haji Ali Juice Centre is one of those places in Mumbai that almost everyone has heard about, and naturally, expectations are quite high before visiting. The menu is extensive, filled with a wide variety of juices, shakes, and desserts that look appealing at first glance. The taste of the items is definitely good—fresh, flavorful, and satisfying to an extent. You can tell that the ingredients are of decent quality and prepared well.

However, beyond that initial impression, nothing truly stands out. There isn’t anything particularly unique or memorable about the flavors that would make you want to come back again and again. It feels like what you get is something you could easily find at many other juice shops across the city.

One of the biggest drawbacks is how overhyped the place feels. Because of its popularity and constant crowd, you go in expecting something exceptional, but the experience turns out to be fairly average. This mismatch between expectation and reality is quite noticeable.

On top of that, the pricing feels a bit on the higher side for what is offered. While the quality is decent, it doesn’t quite justify the cost, making it seem overrated.

Overall, Haji Ali Juice Centre delivers good taste but nothing extraordinary. It’s worth trying once for the experience, but it may not live up to the hype surrounding it.

featured_reviews.name: Mufaddal Patanwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked in the bustling lanes of Colaba, Modern Juice Centre has quietly become one of my most reliable late-night go-to spots. Whenever post-10 pm cravings kick in, this place is almost always on my mind—mainly because it stays open late and never disappoints.

My absolute top picks here are the mulberry juice and tender coconut drink. The mulberry juice has a rich, slightly tangy sweetness that feels both refreshing and indulgent at the same time, while the tender coconut is as clean and hydrating as it gets—perfect balance after a long day.

When it comes to food, their sandwiches and shorma are my default add-ons. The sandwiches are crisp, well-filled, and consistently satisfying, while the shorma is simple but hits the spot, especially late at night when you want something filling yet not too heavy.

What makes this place special is its reliability—you know exactly what you’ll get every single time. No fancy setup, no frills—just good food, quick service, and the comfort of knowing it’s there when most places have shut down. For late-night hunger in South Mumbai, this spot is hard to beat.

featured_reviews.name: Nitika Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been visiting Health juice center located at Matunga King Circle for almost 15years now . Their strawberry milkshake is the ultimate Best I have ever tasted & they have been consistently serving the same taste for so many years which is highly commendable .

When I came to know that Health juice centre is opened in Parel I had to visit it .
I had to meet someone for urgent discussion & was in the same vicinity hence decided to visit the Parel outlet .

The most interesting aspect of this joint is that everything served here is made from scratch fresh in front of you .

They have a wide range of delectable juices , shakes & sandwiches to choose from .
The rates are pocket friendly & the serving quantity is generous & filling for 1 person .
The service is really quick so you dont have to wait too long .They also have home delivery option in the vicinity if you wish to enjoy the hot sandwitches & chilled drinks watching netflix with your friends or family .

I always order the strawberry juice , strawberry malai & strawberry milkshake as they use frozen stawberries instead of artificial syrups & flavours which imparts real sweet tangy taste .

This is the main reason I am a patent customer of Health juice for so many years as it is impossible to find this level of quality in any other restaurant in Mumbai !

The vada pav & samosa grill cheese sandwitch is my top favourite as it is generously overloaded with vegetables served piing hot with chutneys & crisp potato chips .

This outlet also serves the famous street chaats of Mumbai which was exceptionally well made .The paani puri is a must try .

Do visit health juice centre if you are looking for healthy yet tasty food in the real sense of the term .

I hope the management takes steps to improve their inventory management and communication. It's essential to ensure that customers can order what they want, and that staff are knowledgeable about availability. With a few adjustments, I believe Fresh Press Juice Store can provide a better experience for new customers.

Suggestions for improvement:

- Improve inventory management to avoid stockouts
- Update menu boards to reflect available sizes and quantities
- Train staff to be more welcoming and communicative about availability and options

featured_reviews.name: DNB Travel & Food Reviews
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Visited Bunty Juice Center – One of the Most Famous Juice & Snack Spots in Borivali

Visited Bunty Juice Center in Borivali West and had a really enjoyable experience. This place is very popular for its huge variety of juices, shakes, desserts, sandwiches, and snacks with unique presentation style.

🍹 Food & Drinks:
The menu is extremely creative with interesting names and unique serving style. Must-try items include Gabbar Mango Shake, Kiwi Strawberry Juice, Chocolate Thali, Strawberry Cream, Festival Pizza, Chowpatty Sandwich, and Jungli Sandwich. Taste was fresh, flavorful, and presentation was eye-catching.

🍨 Desserts & Presentation:
Desserts and shakes are one of the biggest highlights here. The presentation is very different and trendy, which makes it fun especially for youngsters and families.

💰 Price:
Approx ₹250–₹500 per person depending on your order. Some items feel slightly premium priced, but quantity and creativity balance it well.

🏠 Ambience:
The place has colorful interiors, vibrant atmosphere, and cozy seating. It is usually crowded in evenings and weekends because of its popularity.

👨‍🍳 Staff & Service:
Staff is generally helpful and service is quick even during rush hours. They also guide properly if you are confused by the large menu.

🚗 Parking:
Parking can be difficult during peak time because the area gets crowded. Better to visit slightly early in evenings. They have Velvet parking facility too.

🧼 Cleanliness:
Overall cleanliness is decent considering the heavy crowd, though seating gets busy during peak hours.

📌 Overall:
Great place for juices, desserts, and innovative snacks with fun presentation. Perfect hangout spot for friends and family in Borivali.

Highly recommended 👍

featured_reviews.name: Girlbehindthebrands
featured_reviews.review_text:
When Juices Steal the Show & Food Blows Your Mind! 🍹🍕🔥
Hidden in the heart of Borivali, Bunty’s Snacks & Juice Center is an absolute delight for anyone who loves experimenting with new flavours! 😍

Let’s start with the juices — honestly, they stole the show! From the tangy twist of Captain Juice to the vibrant, colourful Rangoli Juice, each one is refreshing and full of unique blends. The Salaar Juice packs a real punch — bold, chilled, and energizing — while Darna Mana Hai Juice is a fun, must-try surprise for brave hearts! 🥤

Moving to food, every bite is pure comfort. The Humpty Dumpty Toast is a crunchy, cheesy treat that instantly wins you over. The Festival Pizza truly lives up to its name — loaded, flavourful, and festive in every bite! 🍕 The Nachni Bhel is a healthy yet tasty twist, and the Gol Gappa Kabab is a total showstopper — chatpata, crunchy, and bursting with flavour!

And just when you think it can’t get better, the Strawberry Cream and Film City Dessert arrive to seal the deal — creamy, dreamy, and picture-perfect endings! 🍓🍨

If you’re in Borivali and haven’t been here yet, you’re missing out on a local gem. Great taste, quick service, and a vibe that makes you want to come back again and again

featured_reviews.name: kajol patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bunty Cafe is a charming establishment that offers both indoor air-conditioned seating and outdoor seating, allowing guests to enjoy their meals in a setting that suits their preference. One of the standout features of this cafe is its popular range of juices, which are served in a visually appealing and creative way. The presentation adds an extra touch to the overall experience, making it more enjoyable.

A particular highlight was the Chaupati Sandwich, which was full of flavor and left a lasting impression. However, the pasta was a bit of a disappointment. Instead of the expected pasta sauce, it had a taste resembling a paneer gravy, which was not quite what one would expect from a pasta dish.

For dessert, the Strawberry Cream was quite delightful, offering a nice balance of sweetness and freshness. Additionally, the cafe offers a variety of funky juices, each presented with a unique setup that adds to the overall appeal. Although the juice setups are quite fancy, the juices themselves are priced higher than expected, but they remain fairly average in terms of taste.

The ambience of the cafe is simple and unassuming, but it provides a comfortable space for conversations and casual hangouts. It's a great spot for a relaxed chit-chat with friends or family, making it an ideal place to spend time with loved ones over a refreshing drink.

The juices aren’t just tasty—they’re crafted with flair and served with style. The snacks are just as impressive, both in presentation and taste. What truly sets this place apart is the warm and courteous staff. If you’re craving something different and delicious, this place is a must-try!
Quick recommendations-Try Darna mana hai juice 😬
